description: Changes the title of one evidence, or its relevant flag. Evidences are created relevant (true); set relevant=false to leave one out of dossier_group_certify called without evidenceIds, which certifies only the group's relevant evidences. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId, evidence_group_create → evidenceGroupId, and evidence_create → evidenceId passed as id; title and relevant are both optional. Returns no body; confirm with evidence_get, which shows relevant.

relevant.description: Evidences are created with relevant=true. false leaves this evidence out of dossier_group_certify called without evidenceIds, which certifies only the group's relevant evidences; dossier_evidence_list_to_link can filter on relevant.

name: evidence_update
